description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the PhotoAlbum application's database tier from Oracle Database to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including its data model and authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver, update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect, and convert Oracle-specific repository SQL to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents. Convert photo storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea. Replace plaintext database credentials with Managed Identity authentication for Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
